title: 雪泥
subtitle: 自由画布 · 文字创作工作台

timestampSegments.en: Sometimes, a question just occurs to you.
timestampSegments.zh: 有时候，我们只是突然想到一个问题。

timestampSegments.en: No need to structure it first — just say the line that's in your head.
timestampSegments.zh: 不用急着去想大纲。想到什么，就先写下来。

timestampSegments.en: Talk it through with AI — not to think for you, but to dig where you're stuck.
timestampSegments.zh: 像和老朋友聊天一样，把那些模糊的感觉，一层层聊透。

timestampSegments.en: Then let AI go looking. Encyclopedia, images, videos — brought straight back onto the canvas.
timestampSegments.zh: 聊着聊着，需要的背景、老照片、视频资料，都能顺手抓进视野里。

timestampSegments.en: And not just the web — your photos, notes, files, and half-formed thoughts can come in too.
timestampSegments.zh: 还有你过去的旧照片、随手记下的碎片……别担心乱，全铺在这里。

timestampSegments.en: When the canvas is full, keep what actually matters for the writing ahead.
timestampSegments.zh: 思绪全在眼前了。圈出真正打动你的那些，脉络就自然浮现出来。

timestampSegments.en: Finally, hand the important pieces to AI and let it compose the article — every key idea still traces back to its source.
timestampSegments.zh: 最后，把真正重要的内容交给 AI，让它帮你整理成一篇文章。而文章里的每一个重要想法，都可以回到它最初的来源。

timestampSegments.en: From one idea, to a long-form essay.
timestampSegments.zh: 从一个想法，到一篇长文
